QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` ... commented out (`mbedtls_config.h:3787`: `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`) ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (`:2196`) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (`:2185`) are also commented out.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the default header leaves MBEDTLS_THREADING_C commented out, along with the PTHREAD and ALT macros, so a default build defines none of them. That covers both threading macros the item asks about.
